Sail PDF is an open-source PDF workspace for macOS Apple Silicon.

Version 0.11.0 introduces the Sail PDF name and open-sail logo across the desktop app, website and documentation. The existing navy, slate and paper palette is unchanged. English is the default interface language, with Simplified Chinese available in Settings.

Read multiple PDFs, annotate and review, make supported text/image edits, fill forms, organize pages and use an optional document assistant. Existing profile, preference and recovery-data locations are retained during the rename. System-protected credentials may require reauthorization or re-entry after a product-name change; encrypted credential files are never silently removed or downgraded to plaintext.

### Downloads

- **DMG:** the standard Mac installation image.
- **ZIP:** the same application in an archive.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt:** integrity checksums for the downloadable packages.
- **VERIFICATION.txt:** validation details for this release.

### Before installing

This is an **unsigned, non-notarized beta** for **Apple Silicon Macs**. Keep backups and review saved results. Complex paragraph reflow, some fonts and flattened annotations have limitations. Visual signatures are not certificate-based digital signatures.

Standard PDF operations run locally. AI is optional; custom endpoints receive the document context needed for the task. Model weights are downloaded only when requested and are not included.

See the repository README and in-app help for privacy, licensing and known limits.
